<h2 align="center">Papyra 1.0 — the first public release</h2>

<p align="center">
  A calm, self-hosted home for your notes: Google Keep's ease, Obsidian's plain Markdown files,<br>
  live collaboration and passkey-locked notes — in one Docker container you own.
</p>

Everything here has been in daily use through the 0.x releases. 1.0 is the line we now stand behind: the file format, data layout and upgrade path are stable from here on.

```bash
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/main/docker-compose.hub.yml
docker compose -f docker-compose.hub.yml up -d   # → http://localhost:8080
```

## 🌟 Highlights
- **Your notes are plain Markdown files.** Every note is a `.md` file with YAML frontmatter in a folder you own. The database and search index are throwaway caches — delete them and Papyra rebuilds from the files.
- **Edit them anywhere.** Obsidian, Syncthing, Dropbox or git can change the folder behind Papyra's back; it catches up, and real conflicts get a side-by-side resolver.
- **Write together, live.** Shared notes edit in real time with everyone's cursors, presence and per-person undo.
- **Lock what's private.** Locked notes sit behind a vault PIN (plus Face ID / Touch ID / Windows Hello if you like) and are encrypted on disk.
- **One container, nothing else.** No external database, no cloud, no trackers. Multi-arch (amd64 + arm64).

## ✍️ Writing
- Rich editor that saves plain Markdown — headings, lists, to-do lists, quotes, code blocks with syntax highlighting, tables, dividers.
- Slash commands and a grouped formatting toolbar (show it, hide it, or keep it always on).
- `[[Wiki links]]` with backlinks; links follow a note when it's renamed, and dead links say so.
- `@mentions` that notify and can share the note in one step.
- Contents panel for long notes, focus mode for distraction-free writing.
- Autosave, no save button — and opening a note never rewrites it.
- Comments on any passage, with threads and replies.
- **History**: scrub through every distinct version of a note and restore any of them.

## 🖼️ Pictures, files and embeds
- Drop in pictures, GIFs, video, audio and documents; resize, align, caption and drag them around.
- Documents show as desktop-style cards with an in-app preview (PDFs open at the right page).
- **Embed any link** — maps, songs, videos, documents, pages — or turn it into a link card.
- Fast thumbnails (iPhone HEIC included); uploads checked by content and size before they're stored.
- Attachments use Obsidian's `![[file]]` syntax, so the same vault opens in either app.
- Optional, local-only: text in pictures (OCR) and audio recordings (transcripts) become searchable.
- **Read-it-later**: paste a link and Papyra saves a readable copy of the article beside your note.

## 🗂️ Organising
- Keep-style desk: masonry cards, pins, colours, drag to reorder, archive and trash with a countdown.
- Collections and tags, plus **smart collections** built from rules — share them, or copy/import as JSON.
- **To Do** lists with their own page, tickable right from the card.
- Multi-select to pin, archive, share, drag or delete many notes at once.
- Full-text search across notes and attachments, with highlighted matches.
- Your writing, day by day: an activity heatmap in Settings.

## 🤝 Sharing
- Share a note with people on your server as viewer or editor; editors get the full editor and can reshare.
- Notes shared with you live on your desk and in **Shared with me** — tag and pin them for yourself.
- Public links, including one-view links, revocable any time.
- Sharing a note offers the notes it links to; locked notes can never be shared.
- Notifications tray for shares, mentions and access requests.

## 🔐 Accounts and security
- Passkey sign-in, passwords, and two-step sign-in (authenticator app, with email as a fallback).
- See every signed-in device and sign the others out; "remember this device" skips the code.
- Single sign-on (OpenID Connect), configured in Settings — no restart.
- Invite people by email, password resets, and admin user management.
- Every account gets its own walled-off vault on disk; nothing leaks between accounts.
- Delete your account with a grace period.

## 💾 Your data, your way
- Import from **Google Keep** and **Obsidian** (re-importing skips what's already there; big imports resume), or drag files in.
- Zip export with all attachments.
- Encrypted backups you can restore onto a fresh instance.
- Automatic per-account **git mirror** (e.g. GitHub); never force-pushes.

## 🧩 For builders
- Personal access tokens and a documented REST API (OpenAPI + Scalar) — see the [API reference](https://papyra.app/api/).
- AI agents and scripts on an API key can edit live notes — merged into the room, shown in presence — or patch a note by heading.

## 📱 Everywhere
- Installable app (PWA) that works offline and catches up when you're back.
- Light and dark themes in a warm, paper-like design; phone, tablet and desktop layouts.
- WCAG 2.2 AA throughout, checked on every change.
- Progress you can see: busy buttons and an activity dock for longer jobs.

  <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/v1.0.0/.github/release-notes/media/v1.0.0/theme.gif" alt="Switching between the light and dark themes" width="760">
</p>

## 🧰 For self-hosters
- One image (`lyfie/papyra`), one volume. `PUID`/`PGID` set who owns the files.
- Reverse-proxy and HTTPS guides for Caddy and nginx; plain-http LAN mode with `PAPYRA_ALLOW_INSECURE_COOKIES=true`.
- Admin pages for background jobs and scrubbed server logs; `/health` for monitoring.
- Outbound email (SMTP), trash retention and SSO set in the app, not the compose file.
- **Back up your data volume, including `.papyra/keys`** — it holds the keys for locked notes and sessions.

## ⬆️ Upgrading from 0.4.x
Nothing to do — same image, same volume, no breaking changes.

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
```

## 🛟 Support
- **Something broke?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/issues/new) — what you did, what you expected, what happened. Screenshots help.
- **Stuck setting up?** Start with [Troubleshooting](https://papyra.app/docs/troubleshooting/), [Install](https://papyra.app/docs/install/) and [HTTPS & reverse proxies](https://papyra.app/docs/https/).
- **Found a security problem?** Please don't open a public issue — [report it privately](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/security/advisories/new).
- **Have an idea?** Feature requests are issues too. Say what you're trying to do, not only the button you want.

## 🌱 Contribute
- ⭐ **[Star the repo](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra)** and tell a friend — it helps more than you'd think.
- 🧪 Use it and report what breaks — every bug report shapes the next release.
- 📖 Improve the [docs](https://papyra.app/docs/) — the pages live in `papyra.app/src/content/docs/`.
- 🛠️ Send a pull request — read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and open an issue first for anything big. AI-assisted PRs welcome; the bar is the same — you've read, run and tested it.

## 💚 Thanks
Papyra was vibe-coded with AI assistants — a year of work in a few months — on top of [luthor](https://www.luthor.fyi), its own Lexical-based editor. It's a [Lyfie](https://www.lyfie.org) project: free, open software with no trackers. Thank you to everyone who tried the 0.x releases and told us what broke.
